purpose: Ephemeral first-party password-signup proof state; isolates unverified email/password material from canonical Account state until mailbox control is proven.

columns.name: signup_ref
columns.meaning: Public non-secret reference for one independent pending signup challenge.

columns.name: email_address
columns.meaning: Normalized delivery/display email for this pending signup.

columns.name: email_comparison_key
columns.meaning: Canonical email comparison key used for collision checks and bounded cleanup/rate scope.
columns.value_contract: Same comparison policy as EmailIdentity.comparison_key; intentionally not unique.

columns.name: password_verifier
columns.meaning: Argon2id verifier for the submitted signup password, retained only until signup resolution.
columns.value_contract: Argon2id v19 encoded verifier; raw password and pepper secret never stored.

columns.name: password_pepper_key_id
columns.meaning: Non-secret identifier of the external password pepper used for the pending verifier.
columns.value_contract: Trimmed non-empty configured pepper key identifier.

columns.name: otp_verifier
columns.meaning: HMAC-SHA256 verifier for the current six-digit signup email OTP.
columns.value_contract: Exactly 32 bytes; raw six-digit OTP is never persisted.

columns.name: otp_key_id
columns.meaning: Non-secret identifier of the dedicated signup-OTP HMAC key.
columns.value_contract: Trimmed non-empty key identifier; key material remains outside PostgreSQL.

columns.name: updated_at
columns.meaning: Latest mutation instant for OTP rotation/attempt accounting.

columns.name: signup_expires_at
columns.meaning: Terminal lifetime bound for the pending signup.

columns.name: verification_issued_at
columns.meaning: Issue instant for the currently valid email OTP.

columns.name: verification_expires_at
columns.meaning: Expiry instant for the currently valid email OTP.

columns.name: failed_verification_attempts
columns.meaning: Failed guesses against the currently issued OTP.
columns.value_contract: Integer 0..5; resend resets the counter while rotating the verifier.

primary_key.name: pk_password_signup_challenge
primary_key.reason: Stable public reference isolates concurrent anonymous signup attempts.

check_constraints.name: ck_password_signup_challenge_uuidv7
check_constraints.reason: Pending signup references use application-issued UUIDv7.

check_constraints.name: ck_password_signup_challenge_email_comparison_key
check_constraints.reason: Require a canonical non-empty comparison key.

check_constraints.name: ck_password_signup_challenge_password_verifier_format
check_constraints.reason: Pending signup password evidence must use the governed Argon2id format.

check_constraints.name: ck_password_signup_challenge_otp_verifier_length
check_constraints.reason: Signup OTP HMAC-SHA256 verifier is exactly 32 bytes.

check_constraints.name: ck_password_signup_challenge_otp_key_id
check_constraints.reason: Require explicit signup-OTP key routing metadata.

check_constraints.name: ck_password_signup_challenge_chronology
check_constraints.expression_contract: isfinite(created_at) AND isfinite(updated_at) AND isfinite(signup_expires_at) AND isfinite(verification_issued_at) AND isfinite(verification_expires_at) AND updated_at >= created_at AND signup_expires_at > created_at AND verification_issued_at >= created_at AND verification_expires_at > verification_issued_at AND verification_expires_at <= signup_expires_at
check_constraints.reason: Keep pending signup and current OTP windows finite and coherently ordered.

check_constraints.name: ck_password_signup_challenge_failed_attempts
check_constraints.reason: Hard-bound online six-digit OTP guessing per issuance.

indexes.name: ix_password_signup_challenge_email_comparison_key
indexes.reason: Collision resolution, sibling cleanup and bounded maintenance by canonical email key.

indexes.name: ix_password_signup_challenge_signup_expires_at
indexes.reason: Bounded lazy cleanup of expired ephemeral signup state.

state_history.current_binding: Only the row addressed by signup_ref carries the current OTP/password proof for that anonymous signup attempt.
state_history.chronology: Mutable control row, not product history; resend rotates proof material in place.
state_history.immutability_policy: signup_ref, email and password verifier are immutable after creation; only OTP verifier/key/timestamps and failed-attempt counter mutate.

lifecycle.retention: Ephemeral operational state; 24-hour pending-signup bound with lazy/bounded cleanup.
lifecycle.redaction: Email and both verifier fields are security/personal data; raw password, pepper and OTP are forbidden from persistence/logging.
lifecycle.delete_behavior: Runtime DELETE is intentional after successful/existing-account resolution and bounded expiry cleanup.

obligations: M4 real PostgreSQL schema, ACL, mapping, expiry and concurrency proof
